title: Ivywood Escape Relaxing Stay (30+ Day Rental)
description:
This is a 30 or more days rental!
What a cute retreat for your Nashville experience! Fully remodeled 4 bedroom/ 2.5 bath home 4 miles from downtown Nashville. This home comes with a beautiful outdoor area that includes a hot tub, fire pit and an outdoor dining area. The game room features darts,Golden Tee, Karaoke with a stage and a large TV, and several board games for your down time! This home is perfect for a family vacation, bachelorette party or just to get away.  Located in a cul-de-sac!!

The space
CousinsBNB is a well-established host with over 2,200 reviews.  So rest assured this is a top-notch property!

Guest access
You will have access to the entire house, hot tub, and 1 large patio.  There is plenty of parking space for a few cars.

Other things to note
Game room with Golden Tee and a karaoke stage!
